problem.schema: A stopped complete compact response can still be malformed JSON; C4h6 recorded one invalid JSON result and one stale correction despite provider finish_reason stop.
problem.presentation: Current user drafts duplicate large user-report/investigation blocks; complete source quotations belong in review but readability must not be confused with semantic guidance or usefulness.

transport_treatment.off: Existing wire body with response_format absent.

presentation_treatment.changes_only: AnalysisResult.user_draft plus one fixed investigation-rationale sentence only when that sentence would otherwise misdescribe the concise display.
presentation_treatment.ask: Exact canonical question. Only existing eligible ask background (known active USER version, non-version user gap, no current/inherited conflict and selected exact-version records) may append an escaped complete source inventory with source/chunk IDs, safe URL, versions/scope and fixed no-authenticity/cause/fix qualification. Complete quotations remain in review summary; no cut excerpts.
presentation_treatment.answer: Keep all complete selected quotations, including button icon passage. Only shorten duplicated USER-report/code/facts investigation block after source gaps; no new technical synthesis.
presentation_treatment.escalate: Keep source gaps, conflict and uncertainty. Replace repeated full USER-report/code with short proposed-investigation/status/current-active-USER-version text; source gaps never become USER questions.
presentation_treatment.whole_record_bound: Never truncate excerpts, metadata, source reference tokens or supplied qualifications. If whole optional ask inventory cannot fit the draft bound, retain exact original question.
presentation_treatment.prospective_tradeoff: Replacing A full API quotations with source inventory can remove USER-facing API-fact guidance even while preserving the necessary question and source access. Count guidance loss explicitly; shorter text is not a usefulness score.
presentation_treatment.display_comparison: Offline OFF/ON renderer pairing on the identical actual current request/canonical plan. Both paid JSON arms use concise_user_draft ON, so JSON comparison has identical presentation; no attribution of display changes to JSON transport.
presentation_treatment.rationale_exception: For concise answer/escalate investigation display only, replace the fixed sentence claiming USER report/code appears in both user_draft and summary with a fixed accurate sentence: full USER report/reproduction remains in maintainer_summary; current USER version/status is shown in user_draft. All other rationale bytes and all other non-draft fields stay equal. No new technical synthesis.

gate_before_any_paired_scope: Every actual wire payload has exact response_format json_object.
Every actual provider send has HTTP200, verified expected serving-model identity and finish_reason stop.
Every actual compact output has valid raw schema and canonical source binding.
Entire canary route completes with fresh proposals and known complete accounting.
Source/index/input/journal baseline unchanged; no new uncertainty, pending or overrun.
canary.failure: Close entire registered method; retain canary and all unvisited comparisons. Do not retry with OFF/fallback, resume spent identities or regenerate baseline/identities to bypass a stop.

prospective_review.schema: Report raw schema and independent canonical expansion separately, preserve rejected/length/stale/unvisited denominator; JSON object formatting does not prove schema validity, source support or model quality.
prospective_review.decision: Same existing native evidence-conditioned criteria; report necessary questions and defensible abstentions separately from answers and solved cases.
prospective_review.all_surfaces: Review all material claims and current-version applicability, not only evidence_links; compare original vs released/edited separately. Source text remains untrusted data.
prospective_review.A: Necessary version/callback questions; exact-current-source availability or source inventory is not USER-facing API guidance, diagnosis or callback fix.
prospective_review.B: Partial icon guidance only if the actual source passage is selected and delivered; warning/future delivery can remain unresolved.
prospective_review.C: Without Enum-specific evidence, qualified background/investigation only; active1.31.0 initially and1.31.1 after correction, no reasking known facts, source gap or cause/fix fabrication.
prospective_review.presentation: Measure draft chars, complete quote retention, exact non-draft equality except the registered single fixed investigation-rationale sentence, and any loss of actual topical guidance. No automatic usefulness score from shorter text.

old receipts, protocols and closed scope identities
